description: Erection of an outdoor padel court and multi-use games area (MUGA) with associated outdoor gym, seating, lighting and landscaping.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [Unnumbered BNG Metric, d588.0b, 304924-06-ARP-RP-V-0002, d588.2, 304924-06-ARP-RP-YL-0001, Unnumbered Planning Statement, 304924-06-ARP-RP-YF-0001, 304924-ARUP-XX-XX-DR-A-200, 304924-ARUP-XX-XX-DR-A-210, 304924-ARUP-XX-XX-DR-A-180, 304924-ARUP-XX-XX-DR-A-190, 304924-ARUP-XX-XX-DR-A-170, 304924-ARUP-XX-XX-DR-A-160, 304924-ARUP-XX-XX-DR-A-150, 304924-ARUP-XX-XX-DR-A-140, 304924-ARUP-XX-XX-DR-A-130, 304924-ARUP-XX-XX-DR-A-120, 304924-ARUP-XX-XX-DR-A-110, 304924-ARUP-XX-XX-DR-A-101, 304924-06-ARP-XX-RP-C-0001, Unnumbered Biodiversity Net Gain (BNG) Planting Strategy Report].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The lighting details, shown on the approved lighting plan (reference: 304924-06-ARP-RP-YL-0001) (Received: 16/04/2026) and Planning Statement (Received: 16/04/2026) shall be carried out as approved.
Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the are not adversely affected

Condition : 4 - External artificial lighting at the development site shall not exceed lux levels of vertical illumination at neighbouring premises that are recommended by the Institution of Lighting Professionals in the 'Guidance Note 01/2021: Guidance Notes for the Reduction of Obtrusive Light'. Lighting should be minimised, and glare and sky glow should be prevented by correctly using, locating, aiming, and shielding luminaires, in accordance with Guidance Notes.
Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of surrounding premises is not adversely affected by lighting.

Condition : 5 - Prior to the first commencement of the hereby approved development, a Biodiversity Gain Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, the Plan shall include;
(a) information about the steps taken or to be taken to minimise the adverse effect of the development on the biodiversity of the onsite habitat and any other habitat,
(b) the pre-development biodiversity value of the onsite habitat,
(c) the post-development biodiversity value of the onsite habitat,
(d) any registered offsite biodiversity gain allocated to the development and the biodiversity value of that gain in relation to the development,
(e) any biodiversity credits purchased for the development, and
(f) such other matters as the Secretary of State may by regulations specify.
The development shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved Plan prior to the first occupation of the development. Any habitats created or enhanced on-site and off-site in accordance with the Biodiversity Gain Plan must be maintained thereafter for a minimum of 30 years.
Reason. In the interests of improving Biodiversity and in accordance with The Town and Country Planning Act 1990, Section 90A, Schedule 7A.

Condition : 6 - A) Prior to the first commencement of the hereby approved development a Habitat Management and Monitoring Plan (HMMP) prepared in accordance with the approved Biodiversity Gain Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Plan shall include:
(i) a non-technical summary;
(ii) the roles and responsibilities of the people or organisation(s) delivering the HMMP
(iii) the planned habitat creation and enhancement works to create or improve habitat to achieve the biodiversity net gain in accordance with the approved Biodiversity Gain Plan;
(iv) the management measures to maintain habitat in accordance with the approved Biodiversity Gain Plan for a period of 30 years from the completion of development; and 
(v) the monitoring methodology and frequency in respect of the created or enhanced habitat to be submitted to the local planning authority. 

B) No occupation or use of the hereby approved development shall take place until:
(i) the habitat creation and enhancement works set out in the approved HMMP have been completed; and 
(ii) a completion report, evidencing the completed habitat enhancements, has been submitted to, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. 
The created and/or enhanced habitat specified in the approved HMMP shall be managed and maintained in accordance with the approved HMMP.

C) Monitoring reports shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority in writing in accordance with the methodology and frequency specified in the approved HMMP.

Reason. In the interests of improving Biodiversity and in accordance with The Town and Country Planning Act 1990, Section 90A, Schedule 7A.

Condition : 7 - The use of the sports facilities (outdoor padel court, MUGA and outdoor gym) shall not be permitted on the premises between the following hours:
20:00 � 08:00 Monday � Sunday.
Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site/surrounding premises is not adversely affected by noise from activities or people at the site.

Condition : 8 - The proposed lighting within the development shall only be permitted on the premises between the following hours:
08:00 � 20:00 Monday � Sunday.
Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site/surrounding premises is not adversely affected by light from activities or people at the site.
